items.title: Ukraine warns of interceptor missile shortage as 21 killed in Kyiv region
items.description: President Zelensky says Sunday's "massive Russian attack" on Kyiv consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones.

items.title: Huge crowds fill Tehran streets for Khamenei's funeral procession
items.description: Many people were waving Iranian flags and red banners symbolising vengeance for the former supreme leader's war death.

items.title: Wildfire in southern France forces evacuation of 10,000 people
items.description: Tour de France organisers ban spectators from stage three as a wildfire hits the Pyrénées-Orientales region.

items.title: Red card system in disarray over Trump, Fifa and Balogun decision
items.description: The decision to effectively overturn the red card shown to United States forward Folarin Balogun leaves many unanswered questions.

items.title: 'I ate ketchup and cheese,' says Venezuelan girl trapped under quake rubble for 32 hours
items.description: Fabiana was trapped in the rubble of a 10-storey residential building after two earthquakes rocked Venezuela in June.

items.title: At least 25 killed in Sri Lanka prison riots
items.description: The two days of violence at Negombo Prison are the worst prison riots in the country in years.

items.title: Marine Le Pen appeal verdict: Why this moment matters for France
items.description: The leader of France's National Rally leads the opinion polls ahead of the 2027 presidential election and will now find out if she can stand.
